quote: xp = lvl * 5 + 45; var playerHP:int = StatsManager.getPlayerStats(StatsManager.STAT_MAXHP) + StatsManager.findBonusStat(StatsManager.STAT_MAXHP); ... var lvldiff:int = lvl - playerLVL; var hitsToKillBoss:int = 10 + lvldiff; var hitsToKillPlayer:int = 18 - lvldiff; if(hitsToKillBoss <= 3) { hitsToKillBoss = 3; } ... var playerhit:int = playerATK - defense; if(playerLVL <= 10 && playerhit < 1) { playerhit = 1; } else if(playerLVL <= 20 && playerhit < playerLVL / 8) { playerhit = playerLVL / 8; } else if(playerLVL <= 30 && playerhit < playerLVL / 6) { playerhit = playerLVL / 6; } else if(playerhit < playerLVL / 4) { playerhit = playerLVL / 4; } var bossHP:int = playerhit * hitsToKillBoss; if(bossHP > maxhp) { maxhp = bossHP; setHP(maxhp); updateHealthBar(); } var bosshit:int = playerHP / hitsToKillPlayer; var bossATK:int = bosshit + playerDEF; if(bossATK > minDamage) { minDamage = bossATK; } if(lvl <= 5) { minDamage = 1; defense = 1; }
